title: Very comfortable chair, rolls smoothly!
text:
Very comfortable chair, rolls smoothly!. This chair is extremely comfortable. It has an adjustable lumbar pillow and a pillow for your head. It is comfortable enough to use as a chair in the family room! It rolls smoothly and adjusts easily.

It didn't take long to put it together.

The only issue is there were no instructions included.

product_metadata.title: Flash Furniture Foxtrot Reclining Gaming Chair Racing Office Ergonomic PC Adjustable Chair with Adjustable Lumbar Support, Gray/White LeatherSoft
features: Change your gaming experience with a reclining PC chair as you revel in the latest online group game. This gaming chair is well-padded with adjustable lumbar and headrest.
Video game chair with reclining back lever
High back design, adjustable headrest and lumbar pillows, padded arms
Tilt lever - push in to lock in an upright position; pullout to activate rocking motion
PRODUCT MEASUREMENTS >>> Overall Size: 28"W x 28-41.5"D x 48-51.5"H | Seat Size: 15"W x 18.5"D x 18-22"H | Back Size: 18"W x 30"H | Arm Size: 26.5-30.75"H from floor; 9"H from seat
description: Be game ready when you're ready to pick up that controller and get to sit in this brand new gray and white gaming chair. Enjoy endless hours playing your favorite video games in this ergonomic PC chair. Go from sitting to a reclined and relaxed position on this racing game chair with reclining back lever. The racing style back has two pillows that slide up and down to your desired position. Both pillows easily snap off, if you'd like to remove temporarily. You can also rock back and forth and lock the seat in an upright position with the tilt lock handle underneath the seat. Gamers need ergonomic office chairs that'll keep them comfortable for many hours and this reclining gaming chair with adjustable lumbar support will provide optimal support. Purchase this gaming computer chair for your home or for the employees in your office who create and test games.
